method: Bounded, assistant-curated primary-evidence audit; not a systematic review or independent expert assessment. Public models only; no patient-specific functional inference.
objective: Fewer chromosome segregation errors per completed division with preserved survival and proliferation.

suijkerbuijk2010.access: PubMed abstract and indexed primary Results/Figures 3-4 inspected; fullTextXML returned HTTP 500 twice; supplements not inspected

fingolimod2013.access: Indexed primary text; Jak2-driven hematologic models, not BUB1B rescue

crizotinib_label.locator: Section 12.3, specifically pediatric oncology exposure; not an adult or MVA exposure estimate

pexidartinib_label.locator: Section 12.3 Table 9 and boxed warning; browser inspection

experiments.limitation: Genetic complementation, not an approved-drug intervention; does not establish a clinically deliverable treatment.

experiments.model: Engineered BUBR1 replacement cells; I909T or L1012P
experiments.intervention: Force mutant protein expression to wild-type-comparable levels
experiments.limitation: Variant-specific residual function. Not evidence that every missense or truncating allele can be rescued by raising abundance.

experiments.model: MVA-41C and MVA-12C patient-derived fibroblast lines
experiments.intervention: LAP-MIS12-KARD-3D targeting of PP2A-B56 to outer kinetochores
experiments.limitation: MG132 metaphase arrest, 3 h; no demonstration of sustained segregation fidelity and growth after pharmacological treatment.

experiments.model: HeLa; B56 depletion or BUBR1(1-730-I/F) replacement
experiments.intervention: ZM447439, 2 micromolar, 1 h in MG132-arrested cells
experiments.endpoint: chromosome congression; companion B56 experiments assess K-fibers
experiments.limitation: The chemical experiment is in engineered HeLa models, not the patient-cell drug experiment sometimes inferred from this paper. MG132 is an arrest reagent.

experiments.intervention: Hesperadin 50 nM or ZM447439 1 micromolar, 45 min after MG132 arrest
experiments.limitation: PP2A depletion is not the same lesion as BUB1B deficiency; stable attachment is not proof of error-free division.

experiments.result: restored in Foley; failed in Xu, with monopolar spindle phenotype
experiments.limitation: Do not generalize PLK1 inhibition as BUB1B rescue.

experiments.model: Mouse tissues; wild-type and Sirt2-null MEFs
experiments.intervention: NMN; MEF experiment 1 mM for 24 h
experiments.limitation: No demonstrated patient-cell segregation rescue. Mouse lifespan finding concerns SIRT2 transgenesis, not NMN treatment.
Not interchangeable with pharmacological SIRT2 activation or NMN exposure.

experiments.model: Engineered BubR1 lacking PP2A docking domain
experiments.limitation: Alignment cannot serve as a stand-alone functional rescue endpoint.

experiments.intervention: Phosphatase-dominant state or excessive MELT-associated recruitment
experiments.result: weak checkpoint or hyperstable attachments with segregation errors in the respective constructs
experiments.limitation: Global PP2A activation or Aurora B inhibition cannot be assumed beneficial across exposure levels and lesions.

exposure_checks.name: AXITINIB
exposure_checks.context: Label adult RCC cohort geometric mean at 5 mg twice daily, fed; highly variable exposure
exposure_checks.assay_comparison: AURKB Kd 11 nM and 236 nM; no functional rescue concentration
exposure_checks.decision: No credible exposure-supported AURKB rescue nomination

exposure_checks.name: CRIZOTINIB
exposure_checks.context: Label pediatric oncology cohort at 280 mg/m2 twice daily; not a patient-dose proposal or adult/MVA exposure estimate
exposure_checks.assay_comparison: Binding Kd 76 and 1240 nM; >80% biochemical inhibition at 500 nM
exposure_checks.decision: Binding overlap alone insufficient; cellular AURKB engagement and rescue unknown

exposure_checks.name: PEXIDARTINIB
exposure_checks.context: Label mean steady-state exposure at older fasted regimen, described as similar to recommended fed-regimen exposure
exposure_checks.assay_comparison: AURKB IC50 643 nM; separate kinobead Kd >30000 nM
exposure_checks.decision: Exposure concern, conflicting assays and major liver toxicity; no rescue nomination

exposure_checks.name: MOMELOTINIB
exposure_checks.context: Label steady-state exposure at maximum recommended dosage
exposure_checks.assay_comparison: <50% inhibition at 100 nM; >50% at 1000 nM; kinobead Kd >30000 nM
exposure_checks.decision: No established cellular efficacy window; do not convert IC50 <1000 nM into a precise potency

additional_transfer_checks.name: FINGOLIMOD
additional_transfer_checks.limitation: Parent and phosphorylated species have different, context-dependent effects. Global PP2A modulation does not establish PP2A-B56 recruitment at kinetochores. No BUB1B rescue concentration or applicable unbound exposure margin established.

additional_transfer_checks.name: Proteasome inhibitors
additional_transfer_checks.limitation: MG132 arrests cells for scoring; its use does not demonstrate therapeutic rescue or justify substituting an approved proteasome inhibitor.

decision.next_dependency: Relevant model with residual BubR1/function measurements and genetic positive controls; quantify errors per division, attachment maturation, checkpoint function and growth.
